description: Default capability for the main window. Without this file, Tauri 2 denies the WebView permission to use listen()/emit() over IPC, so app.emit() from the Rust side is silently dropped on the frontend (invoke() of custom commands still works — that's not under the same ACL). `core:default` is the standard scaffold permission alias; `core:event:default` is the specific one we need for the streamed search events.
